run_compute_embeddings: run the script to compute text embeddings from the Yarn-art-style dataset and save to parquet
load_flux_dev_pipeline: load the FLUX.1-dev pipeline with 8-bit quantized T5 text encoder for embedding computation
compute_embeddings: compute prompt embeddings, pooled embeddings, and text IDs for a list of prompts using the FLUX pipeline
generate_image_hash: generate a SHA-256 hash from an image tensor to uniquely identify images in the dataset
summarize_run: summarize the run function that loads a dataset, computes embeddings, and serializes results to parquet
